source.note: The current main ref contains a damaged but substantial Vite and React music-playground alpha. Patterns were reconstructed from direct file reads rather than commit-summary metadata.

patterns.name: Sound-as-Object Tile
patterns.thesis: Represent a musical role as a small draggable object so a person can act on sound directly before learning channel, track, or signal-routing abstractions.
observedImplementation: Drums, Bass, and Melody represented as named Vibe Tiles
drop into a shared Vibe Board
requiredControls: no essential meaning carried by audio alone

patterns.name: No-Wrong-Notes Constraint Field
patterns.evidence: product thesis and implemented bounded sample set
patterns.thesis: Move difficulty into the curation of compatible materials so exploration can stay expressive without relying on correction, grading, or prerequisite theory.
observedImplementation: role-based labels rather than theory-first controls
tagline and product framing around no wrong notes
requiredControls: preserve a route to deeper controls
risks: claiming every output is objectively good

patterns.name: Immediate Auditory Consequence
patterns.thesis: Make the consequence of placement perceptible immediately so understanding emerges through action and listening rather than explanation alone.
observedImplementation: new loop joins the active mix immediately

patterns.name: Play-to-Artifact Capture
patterns.thesis: Allow an ephemeral creative state to become a locally owned artifact through explicit recording and download.
observedImplementation: explicit start and stop recording control

quarantine: the current layered loop field described as a true sequenced timeline
sound used as the only state signal
